Matched.description: contains evaluates the items it matches, and no other item is admitted: every item is a string, and there is one at least.

Bounded.description: Every item matches contains, so minContains and maxContains bound the length.

Impossible.description: More items than maxContains admits are required.

Typed.description: An item contains does not match is of the type unevaluatedItems says; which item is a string no type says.

Prefixed.description: Items past prefixItems are those contains matches, and a number never does: a string follows it.

NoneMatch.description: maxContains 0: no item matches contains, so it evaluates none.

NoneMatchUnsaid.description: maxContains 0: the items are of the type unevaluatedItems says; the strings contains does not match no type says.

NoneMatchApart.description: Nor does it where it would match items of another type: no item is 1.

NoneMatchBeside.description: A member's contains with maxContains 0 evaluates none: the other contains alone evaluates the items, which it says.

Untyped.description: Without type, the items contains evaluates are an array of them.

InAllOf.description: contains in an allOf member evaluates the items it matches.

ViaRef.description: contains in a $ref target evaluates the items it matches.

TwoSources.description: An item matches one contains or the other; which no type says.

Either.description: An anyOf member's contains evaluates the items it matches where the member matches, and both may.

Undecided.description: else evaluates where if does not admit the value, which TypeScript cannot say here: unevaluatedItems is ignored, and so which items match contains is not typed.
